english.note: Use this when the emphasis is on a premium, upscale, or exclusive quality rather than simply being good.

exampleSentences.english: They had dinner at a select restaurant.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋喺一間高級餐廳食飯。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 jat1 gaan1 gou1 kap1 caan1 teng1 sik6 faan6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something stylish, upscale, or exclusive.

exampleSentences.english: This restaurant is posh, but not outrageously expensive.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢間餐廳環境高級，但價錢唔算離譜。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 waan4 ging2 gou1 kap1 daan6 gaa3 cin4 m4 syun3 lei4 pou2

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 sik6 gou1 kap1 ngau4 paa2

english.note: Use this when designer means upscale or luxurious and the item need not be made by a designer.

exampleSentences.english: We booked a designer hotel for this trip.

english.note: Use this when luxurious mainly means high-end or superior in quality rather than especially comfortable.

exampleSentences.english: This shop specializes in luxurious leather goods.

english.note: Use this for higher rank, status, grade, or quality rather than an ordinary comparison.

exampleSentences.english: This hotel is far superior in quality.

english.note: Choose this when “fancy” means superior in quality or high-end rather than ornate or complicated.

exampleSentences.english: We’re going out for fancy French food tonight.
